name: VAV-Compact
summary: 공개 통합 포인트 리스트에서 자동 추출했다. Modbus 29점

points.name: Setpoint Setpoint for actuator between Min (Register No. 106) and Max (No. 107)
Override Control Override setpoint with defined values
points.note: 범위 0: None 1: Open 2: Close 3: Min 4: Mid 5: Max Default: None(0) · Modbus reg 1

points.name: Command Initiation of actuator functions for service and test After command is sent, register returns to None(0) With Reset(4) all Malfunction and Service Information (Register No. 105) Information can be reset.
points.note: 범위 0: None 1: Adaption 2: Test 3: Sync 4: Reset Default: None(0) · Modbus reg 2

points.name: Actuator Type
points.note: 범위 0: Actuator not connected 1: Air / Water 2: VAV / EPIV 3: Fire 4: Energy Valve 5: 6way EPIV · Modbus reg 3

points.name: Relative Position
Absolute Position The unit depends on the device: [°] for actuators with rotary movement [mm] for actuators with linear movement
Relative volumetric flow Relative volumetric flow of Vnom
Absolut volumetric flow

Sensor 1 Value Current value of sensor 1, depending on the setting of the Sensor 1 Type (Register No. 108) [mV] if Sensor 1 Type (Register No. 108) is Active(1) [0 / 1] if Sensor 1 Type (Register No. 108) is Switch(4)
Absolute volumetric flow Absolute flow in unit selected (Register No. 118) LowWord Lower 16 bit of 32 bit value
Absolute volumetric flow Absolute flow in unit selected (Register No. 118) HighWord Upper 16 bit of 32 bit value
Setpoint Analog Shows the setoint in % if actuator is control by analog signal
Bus Termination Indicates if bus termination (120 Ω) is enabled Bus termination can be set with the configuration tools
points.note: 범위 0: inactive 1: active Default: inactive(0) · Modbus reg 99

points.name: Series Number 1st part Each device has an unambiguous series number, which is either impressed on or glued to the housing The series number consists of 4 segments, although only parts 1, 2 and 4 are displayed on Modus Example: 00839-31324-064-008 1st part: 00839 2nd part: 31324 4th part: 008
Series Number 2nd part
Series Number 4th part
Firmware Version Firmware version of communication module Example: 302, Version 3.02

Malfunction and Service Information Value is bit-coded. More than one bit can be set to 1 All bits not montioned in the enumeration are not used for this actuator range Mechanical travel increased: The actuator has been moved outside the adapted working range Actuator cannot move: Mechanical overload e.g. blocked actuator, etc. Internal activity: Actuator performs a test run, adaption, etc. Gear disengaged: The gear disengaged button is pressed Bus Watchdog triggered: Timeout for the Bus Watchdog expired
points.note: 범위 Bit1: Mech travel increased Bit2: Actuator cannot move Bit8: Internal activity Bit9: Gear disengaged Bit10: Bus Watchdog triggered · Modbus reg 104

points.name: Vmin Min has to be ≤ Max
Vmax Max has to be ≥ Min and > 20%
Sensor 1 Type If Setpoint Source (Register 119) is analog (Hybrid mode) the sensor type 1 can be set to Active(1) in order to see the Setpoint Analog in mV
points.note: 범위 0: None 1: Active / Hybrid 2: – 3: – 4: Switch Default: None(0) · Modbus reg 107

points.name: Bus Fail Position Modbus communication is not monitored as standard. In the event of a breakdown in communication, the actuator retains the current setpoint The bus implementation tracks the Modbus communication. If neither the Setpoint (Register No. 1) nor the Override Control (Register No. 2) is renewed before the Timeout for Bus Watchdog (Register No. 110) expires, the actuator controls to the Bus Fail Position Triggered bus watchdog is indicated in the Malfunction and Service Information (Register No. 105)
points.note: 범위 0: None / Last setpoint 1: Fast close 2: Fast open 3: Mid position (parameterized) Default: None(0) · Modbus reg 108

points.name: Timeout for Bus Watchdog in s Time until Bus Fail will be detected. If Bus Watchdog = 0 then deactivated If Bus Fail Position (Register No. 110) different from 0, the Bus Fail Position becomes active after the Timeout for Bus Watchdog is expired
points.note: 범위 0...3‘600 Default: 0 If Bus Fail Position (Register No. 110) not None(0), then Default: 120 · Modbus reg 109

points.name: Nominal volumetric flow
Nominal volumetric flow Vnom in unit selected (Register 118) LowWord Lower 16 bit of 32 bit value
Nominal volumetric flow Vnom in unit selected (Register 118) HighWord Upper 16 bit of 32 bit value
Control Mode
points.note: 범위 0: Position control 1: Flow control · Modbus reg 116

points.name: Unit Selection Flow
points.note: 범위 0: m3/s 1: m3/h 2: l/s 3: l/min 4: l/h 5: gpm 6: cfm Default: m3/h(1) · Modbus reg 117

points.name: Setpoint Source Analog: Setpoint from analog signal 0 ... 10 V on wire 3 Bus: Setpoint from Modbus (Register 1)
points.note: 범위 0: Analog 1: Bus Default: Bus(1) · Modbus reg 118

gap: 정격 성능(용량·소비전력·효율)은 이 문서에 없다 — 제품 카탈로그가 따로 필요하다. 정격은 제품 데이터시트에서 왔다(통신 맵에는 없다). 담은 것은 요구 항목(e16.actuator·e16.valve·e6.vav)뿐이다 — 재질·보호등급·배선 규격은 계산에 안 들어가 담지 않았다.
